title: The iPhone 5 is now considered 'vintage' by Apple (AAPL)
text: The iPhone 5 is now considered 'vintage' by Apple (AAPL) Thursday, 1 November 2018 ( 2 hours ago ) · Apple will no longer support the iPhone 5 with repairs, as it is now considered "vintage." · There are now few options for people who prefer smartphones with displays under 5 inches.
